title: LedgerLLM — Admin
description: Operator/admin view over the production Neon database (read-only replica). Exact values from the ledger and audit tables, durable across restarts. Read-only by design: suspend, revoke, rotate and plan changes go through /admin/*. Owner: Yashraj.

panels.title: Fleet — the whole platform at a glance
Fleet totals
panels.description: Straight from the ledger and the tenant tables, so these are exact rather than sampled: the same numbers an invoice would be built from. Month-to-date figures reset on the 1st UTC.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) as "Tenants",
       (select count(*) from api_keys where revoked_at is null) as "Active keys",
       (select count(*) from users) as "Portal users",
       (select coalesce(sum(cost_microusd),0)/1e6 from usage_ledger
          where created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) as "Spend MTD (USD)",
       (select count(distinct request_id) from usage_ledger
          where created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) as "Requests MTD"
from tenants

panels.title: Tenants — who they are and what they owe
Tenants, spend and budget
panels.description: `limit_usd` is blank until a tenant's first request of the month: the budget_periods row is created on first reserve, and before that the limit lives in config/plans.yaml (or the tenant's override). pct_used is spend against the hard limit, which is what the 402 cutoff compares.

targets.rawSql:
select t.name as "Tenant", t.plan as "Plan", t.status as "Status",
       round(coalesce(b.spent_microusd,0)/1e6::numeric, 6) as "Spent USD",
       round(nullif(coalesce(b.hard_limit_microusd, t.budget_override_microusd, 0),0)/1e6::numeric, 2) as "Limit USD",
       case when coalesce(b.hard_limit_microusd,0) > 0
            then round(100.0*coalesce(b.spent_microusd,0)/b.hard_limit_microusd, 1) end as "% used",
       round(coalesce(b.reserved_microusd,0)/1e6::numeric, 6) as "Reserved USD",
       (select count(*) from api_keys k where k.tenant_id=t.id and k.revoked_at is null) as "Keys",
       (select max(created_at) from usage_ledger l where l.tenant_id=t.id) as "Last call"
from tenants t
left join budget_periods b on b.tenant_id=t.id and b.period=to_char(now(),'YYYY-MM')
order by 4 desc

panels.title: Spend per day by tenant (USD)
panels.description: Daily spend from usage_ledger. Exact, and unaffected by restarts — unlike the Prometheus cost counter on the operational dashboard, which resets with the process.

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', l.created_at) as time, t.name as metric,
       sum(l.cost_microusd)/1e6 as value
from usage_ledger l join tenants t on t.id=l.tenant_id
where $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Latency — against the targets in DESIGN.md §1
End-to-end latency on /v1/summarize
panels.description: Exact percentiles over request_logs rows, not a histogram estimate. Target from DESIGN.md §1 is p50 <= 3s and p99 <= 8s; the panel turns red past 8s.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) as "Requests",
       percentile_disc(0.50) within group (order by latency_ms) as "p50 ms",
       percentile_disc(0.95) within group (order by latency_ms) as "p95 ms",
       percentile_disc(0.99) within group (order by latency_ms) as "p99 ms",
       count(*) filter (where latency_ms > 8000) as "Over 8s"
from request_logs where endpoint='/v1/summarize' and status_code=200
  and $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Platform overhead (end-to-end minus model time)
panels.description: Our own cost per request: the HTTP duration from request_logs minus the provider call from the ledger. Target is p99 <= 25ms. In production this is dominated by DATABASE ROUND TRIPS, not CPU - the pipeline makes ~19 database calls per request, so a Render region far from the Neon region adds that many network hops. Measured locally with the database on the same host: 7-10ms.

targets.rawSql:
select percentile_disc(0.50) within group (order by gap) as "p50 ms",
       percentile_disc(0.95) within group (order by gap) as "p95 ms",
       max(gap) as "max ms"
from (select r.latency_ms - coalesce(l.latency_ms,0) as gap
      from request_logs r
      left join usage_ledger l on l.request_id=r.request_id and l.purpose='completion'
      where r.endpoint='/v1/summarize' and r.status_code=200
        and $__timeFilter(r.created_at)) g

panels.title: Recent requests
panels.description: One row per HTTP request, newest first. error_code is null on success. The model column shows which model actually answered, so a fallback (D19) is visible here.

targets.rawSql:
select r.created_at as "When", t.name as "Tenant", r.status_code as "Status",
       r.error_code as "Error", r.latency_ms as "Latency ms", r.model as "Model",
       round(r.cost_microusd/1e6::numeric, 6) as "Cost USD"
from request_logs r left join tenants t on t.id=r.tenant_id
where $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
order by r.created_at desc limit 100

panels.title: Outcomes by error code
panels.description: Every refusal reason plus successes. 402 budget_exceeded and 429 rate_limited are designed outcomes, not faults - this is the breakdown the burst test drives.

panels.title: Audit — why was this refused, and who changed what
Recent audit events
panels.description: The answer to a customer asking why they were refused, and the trail of every admin and portal action. Filter the Event column for budget.exceeded, blocked_input, key.revoked, tenant.updated.

targets.rawSql:
select a.created_at as "When", a.event_type as "Event", a.actor as "Actor",
       t.name as "Tenant", a.request_id as "Request", a.details::text as "Details"
from audit_events a left join tenants t on t.id=a.tenant_id
where $__timeFilter(a.created_at)
order by a.created_at desc limit 200
